title: FactChange
description: One fact change a decision emits. See the module docs.

oneOf.description:
Create an object. A lifecycle property it writes must hold an initial
state; one it omits takes its default, which is an initial state.

additionalProperties.description: Exact JSON value. Number tokens retain decimal precision and are not binary64 values. Preserve source text or use an exact-decimal JSON parser; JavaScript JSON.parse may lose precision.

oneOf.description: Set one stored property. Never a lifecycle property.

value.description: Exact JSON value. Number tokens retain decimal precision and are not binary64 values. Preserve source text or use an exact-decimal JSON parser; JavaScript JSON.parse may lose precision.

oneOf.description: Fire a declared transition of the lifecycle of property `lifecycle`.

lifecycle.description: The lifecycle property (it names the lifecycle: one per property).

transition.description: The transition id, declared by that lifecycle.

ObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

PropertyId.description: Id of a property within its object type (`sku_code`), unique there.

TransitionId.description:
Id of a [`Transition`], unique within its lifecycle. Same grammar as a
property id ([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]).
